market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Fed hike creates immediate headwind for risk assets but oil decline and inflation tempering provide offset. Crypto regulatory failure adds tail risk. Asian markets pressured by dollar strength. Expect 2-4% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks. Gold and commodities outperform. Watch for Trump-Fed conflict escalation.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle (memory, storage, infrastructure) and energy resilience themes offer 12-month upside. Vietnam/EM upgrade cycle supports emerging market re-rating. However, AI regulatory cliff within 12 months and potential inflation reacceleration (RBA concerns, El Niño food prices) cap upside. Consumer selectivity persists, favoring value over growth.
